name: Offboarding - create checklist
description: Two-page n8n form that reads the live General tools Confluence page, builds a per-person offboarding tool checklist xlsx in the OneDrive Offboardings folder, registers it, and DMs each access owner on Slack.

parameters.formDescription: Generates the tool checklist spreadsheet from the live General tools Confluence page and DMs each access owner on Slack.

options.formDescription: One row per access owner on the General tools page. Change an email to reassign a person for this offboarding only. Untick a person to skip pinging them. Leave an email empty and nobody is pinged for their tools.

value.file_url: ={{ $('Create edit share link').first().json.link?.webUrl || $('Upload checklist to OneDrive').first().json.webUrl }}

parameters.completionMessage: ={{ $('Build offboarding record').first().json.fileName }} is in the Offboardings folder. Access owners have been DM'd on Slack. Owners with no email set (nobody pinged): {{ $('Build offboarding record').first().json.ownersWithoutEmail || 'none' }}
